[mathpix-mcp](https://github.com/georgedouzas/mathpix-mcp) is a Model Context Protocol server for [Mathpix](https://mathpix.com)
OCR. It lets an LLM or agent turn images and PDF, DOCX or PPTX documents into LaTeX and Markdown.

It's written in Ruby, so you need Ruby 3.2 or newer and your own Mathpix credentials:

```bash
gem install mathpix-mcp
export MATHPIX_APP_ID=your-app-id
export MATHPIX_APP_KEY=your-app-key
mathpix-mcp
```

That runs it over stdio. There is also a `mathpix-mcp-http` executable for Streamable HTTP, with bearer-token authentication. An
agent that connects gets these tools:

```
convert_image_tool
convert_document_tool
convert_strokes_tool
batch_convert_tool
check_document_status_tool
search_results_tool
get_usage_tool
get_account_info_tool
list_formats_tool
```

OCR output is always written to a file and never returned inline. The tool sends back a path, a short preview and some metadata.
A long PDF can produce a lot of text, and this stops it from overflowing the model's context.
